gap: No result ChatGPT got states which Lumary gimbal generations work with Lumary's own smart dimmer wall switch. I could not open the maker page to confirm this, so the finding below is only the general 2.4 GHz pairing requirement, which ChatGPT's answer already mentions.
standout_why: I could not open any of the cited rival pages because of repeated HTTP 429 errors and timeouts: the lumarysmart.com 9 W, RGBAI Pro and Ultra product pages, the lumaryusa.com pages, the Best Buy L-GL4B4 and Pro pages, and the Wayfair LMAF1001 page. The only thing I could compare against is ChatGPT's answer text. It already says these models 'generally need constant power and aren't designed for traditional dimmer switches' and that 'most of these use 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi'. The one compatibility fact I sourced, the 2.4 GHz pairing requirement, therefore adds nothing new.
decides: It doesn't change the pick. The 2.4 GHz requirement applies to every Lumary Wi-Fi candidate, so it is a buying caveat and doesn't separate the models. The finding that could decide the pick is unverified (see unsourced). That finding is which gimbal models Lumary's dimmer switch supports: if the Pro and Ultra are left out, the 9 W model becomes the pick for anyone who wants a physical wall dimmer. Re-run once lumarysmart.com stops rate-limiting.
